recipient_role: Yan Yean Road Upgrade, South Package
company_line: McConnell Dowell is delivering the South Package of the Yan Yean Road Upgrade in Melbourne's north.
subject: Junior Project Engineer - Traffic (SEEK 95705736)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Junior Project Engineer - Traffic role on the South Package of the Yan Yean Road Upgrade. A road project that gives a recently qualified engineer exposure across engineering, construction, commercial and safety is the kind of start I want.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and studied the Austroads road and pavement guides and AS 1742.14. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections and safety checks. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site reports and progress reports.

I live in Melton, hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not worked in traffic engineering yet, so I would be learning that side with your team.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
